# Caspeco

> Caspeco makes software for the hospitality industry (restaurants, bars, cafés, hotels, amusement parks and arenas): POS and payments, booking, staff management, analytics and AI assistants, sold as one connected system.

The site is available in Swedish (the default, at the root), English (/en), Norwegian (/no), French (/fr), Belgian French (/frbg) and Dutch (/nl). Page paths differ per language; the links below are the English pages. For another language, use the language switcher or the sitemap.

## Products

- [POS system for restaurants](https://www.caspeco.com/en/pos-system-restaurant): Caspeco's POS system for restaurants, bars and hotels.
- [POS features](https://www.caspeco.com/en/cash-system-functions): Key features of the POS system.
- [Mobile POS](https://www.caspeco.com/en/mobile-pos-system): Take orders and payments at the table.
- [Table service](https://www.caspeco.com/en/table-service-restaurant): Table service for restaurants.
- [SoftPOS](https://www.caspeco.com/en/softpos): Accept contactless card payments on a phone, without a traditional card terminal.
- [Caspeco Kiosk](https://www.caspeco.com/en/self-ordering-kiosk-caspeco-kiosk): Self-ordering kiosk for express checkout.
- [Online ordering](https://www.caspeco.com/en/online-order): Online ordering for takeout and delivery.
- [Delivery for restaurants](https://www.caspeco.com/en/delivery-restaurants): Delivery orders without extra printers and tablets.
- [Trivec POS](https://www.caspeco.com/en/product/trivec-kassa): Trivec POS system for restaurants, bars and hotels.
- [Terminals](https://www.caspeco.com/en/terminals): Payment terminals.
- [Sunmi accessories and specifications](https://www.caspeco.com/en/sunmi): Hardware accessories and specifications.
- [Booking system](https://www.caspeco.com/en/product/booking-system-for-restaurants-hotels-and-bars): Reservations for restaurants, bars and hotels.
- [Booking system features](https://www.caspeco.com/en/booking-system-features): Key features of the booking system.
- [Activity booking](https://www.caspeco.com/en/activity-booking-restaurant-industry): Activity booking for the restaurant industry.
- [Staff management](https://www.caspeco.com/en/product/staff-management-system-for-bars-restaurants-and-hotels): Scheduling, performance and payroll.
- [Staff system features](https://www.caspeco.com/en/personnel-system-functions): Payroll, time and scheduling features.
- [Analytics](https://www.caspeco.com/en/product/powerful-analytics-for-the-restaurant-industry): Analytics for the restaurant industry.
- [Analytics features](https://www.caspeco.com/en/analysis-functions): Advanced analytics features.
- [Casper, AI assistant](https://www.caspeco.com/en/casper): AI assistant for hospitality: ask about sales, staffing and more.
- [Guest Assistant](https://www.caspeco.com/en/guest-assistant): Answers guests 24/7 over phone, chat, Instagram or their own AI assistant, and takes bookings.
- [Software overview](https://www.caspeco.com/en/software): Overview of Caspeco's software.
- [Integrations](https://www.caspeco.com/en/integrations): Systems Caspeco integrates with.

## Solutions by stage

- [Opening soon](https://www.caspeco.com/en/solutions/opening-soon): Set up sales, staff, bookings and reporting before the first guest arrives.
- [Levelling up](https://www.caspeco.com/en/solutions/levelling-up): Replace a patchwork of tools with a connected setup.
- [Adding locations](https://www.caspeco.com/en/solutions/adding-locations): Run a second, third or fifth site consistently.
- [Operating at scale](https://www.caspeco.com/en/solutions/operating-at-scale): Staff cost, payroll and margins for every venue in one view.
